title: Actions
subtitle: Your workflows. Your runners. One place to follow every job.
emptyDescription: Connect a workflow from your repository and run it on an authorized server or a temporary Cloud runner.
noRunsHint: Your workflow runs and their results will appear here.
noRunnersHint: Use a connected server, including macOS, or an available temporary Cloud runner.
cancellingHint: Stopping the worker. Its slot stays reserved until execution has ended.
approvalHint: This pull request comes from a fork. Approval runs its code in a disposable Cloud VM without stored secrets or write tokens.
queuedLogs: Logs will appear when this job starts.
selectJob: Select a job to inspect its steps and logs.
name: Name
sourceHint: Repository workflows are loaded from the exact commit for each run.
secretsHint: Values are encrypted. Leave existing secrets empty to keep them.
destinationsHint: Jobs use their runs-on labels to match these runners. A Linux container cannot run macOS jobs.
forksHint: Every fork run needs approval and a disposable Cloud runner.
nativeHint: Run trusted jobs directly on the selected server. Uses its installed tools.
containerHint: Linux jobs run in Docker using the selected runner image.
trustedHint: Connected servers run trusted code only. Native jobs can access files owned by the connected user; container jobs also share this host's Docker daemon.
labelsHint: Separate labels with commas. OS and architecture come from the server.
nativeLimits: Native jobs use host resources. CPU and memory limits apply to container jobs.
onlineHint: Webhooks and schedules need this control plane to stay online. Publish it to keep workflows running while Desktop is closed.
storageHint: Use a connected storage destination for artifacts and dependency caches. Requires a published controller. Up to 1 GiB per upload, with 7 days of retention by default.
stepsPending: Steps appear when the runner starts.
manualHint: Add workflow_dispatch to this workflow to run it manually.

budget.label: Budget
budget.title: Actions budget
budget.subtitle: One prepaid balance for temporary Cloud VMs and transfer. Separate from your server plans.
budget.chargedTime: Estimates assume full CPU and RAM use, before transfer or disk I/O. Actual charges follow measured VM usage, including preparation and cleanup. Queue time uses no VM.
budget.transferPolicy: CPU time, measured memory and transfer share one balance. Workers stop when Oblien marks it exhausted; recent usage can take time to appear.
budget.artifacts: Artifacts and caches use your configured storage destination.
budget.empty: Your verified deposits will appear here.
budget.unavailable: Cloud Actions payments are temporarily unavailable.
budget.connected: Connected servers run workflows without using this Actions budget.
budget.preparing: Funds added. Preparing your Cloud runners…
budget.balanceUnavailable: Balance is temporarily unavailable. Retry to refresh it.
budget.pricingUnavailable: Live rates are unavailable. Retry before adding funds.
budget.maxParallel: {count} Cloud jobs at once, shared across all runner sizes.
budget.setupRetrying: Your funds are saved. Cloud runner setup is retrying automatically.
budget.paused: Cloud Actions is paused. Your balance is saved; contact support if it remains paused.
